authorities.sign: Spot legs (even indices) remain >= 0 (never net short); perpetual legs (odd indices) are bidirectional within [-0.55, 0.55] and accrue signed funding on held quantities; all transaction fees, spread, and sqrt-impact charges strictly debit cash.
authorities.state: BookState owns realized cash, exact quantities, and drawdown metrics across alternating spot/perp legs; ShadowAnchorMtfPolicy maintains internal causal EMA action smoothing (ema_decay=0.70) and emits hold_current_quantity_symbols outside rebalance bars or within deadband=0.04 unless drawdown >= drawdown_start; on non-rebalance bars at or beyond drawdown_start it re-proposes the cached pre-risk target of the last rebalance so PreTradeRisk applies risk_scale exactly once (no compounding), and the rebalance-bar deadband is released during drawdown. While risk_scale < 1 an exact-quantity HOLD is impossible (risk would rescale the held weights), so when risk_scale is unchanged or higher and the risk-scaled target is inside the deadband (L1 < 0.04) the policy proposes the pre-image current/risk_scale that risk maps back onto the current weights, suppressing drift churn; ANY decrease of risk_scale since the previous decision re-targets the intended book. The residual turnover is close-to-open gap drift that still re-trades on part of the non-rebalance breach bars in every mode including the Non-RL anchors (cost-charged, not an accounting defect), bounded by a replay test on a synthetic fixture and disclosed in the spec.

thesis.cheapest_falsifier: Three pre-economic synthetic G2 oracles plus architecture boundary checks (zero market data accessed): (1) future-bar perturbation + SPOT_HALTS gap test proving 0.0 pre-cut feature/gate/proposal leakage and fail-closed Pre-FS1 embargo refusal >= 2026-08-01T00:00:00, (2) zero-residual algebraic equivalence (< 1e-12 vs ANC_BIDIR_75_25), deadband/non-rebalance HOLD invariance with drawdown HOLD release, processing_bar_volume_capacity=False future-volume shock invariance, and fit_stop_index > start_index refusal, and (3) independent 50-digit pure-Python Decimal 2-pair/4-leg ledger oracle reconciling run_shared_portfolio_replay within 2e-9 abs / 2e-12 rel.
thesis.counter_hypothesis: Apparent scratch outperformance across Pre-FS1 Rounds 1-11 (cumulative N=450-900 exploratory trials; DSR_null=0.788/0.721 < 0.95) and RL regime adaptation (Round 12 H13-A NOT SUPPORTED, H13-B NOT SUPPORTED) is spurious or matched by Non-RL controls due to: (1) Tier D multiple-testing selection bias on [2021-01-01, 2026-08-01), (2) scratch simplifications absent from trade_rl (continuous unquantized weights, quadratic rather than native sqrt impact, missing 1% trailing participation cap, no minimum_notional=10.0 rejection, simplified margin), (3) asymmetric spot/perp partial fills breaking neutrality, and (4) fixed causal ANC_REGIME_GATE_NONRL matching or dominating RL drawdown/Sharpe throttling cleanly without neural policy variance.
thesis.economic_mechanism: Causal 4h/1d/3d/1w alignment (15m/1h inputs are 4h-OHLC proxies unless external micro arrays with causal availability are supplied), flow, carry, and crowding signals identify when the fixed daily-rebalanced ANC_BIDIR_75_25 baseline (directional leg = normalized(0.75*w_aw_regime + 0.25*w_perp_bidir_carry) scaled by 1.5*vol_cushion_tail; carry leg = 0.5*c_weekly_iv) faces elevated short-term flow toxicity or crowded funding; a sparse soft-thresholded (|a|>0.05) residual policy shifts weights across orthogonalized factors to mitigate adverse selection and net turnover, while ANC_REGIME_GATE_NONRL scales alpha/carry directly from causal 6D regime opportunity state without RL.

thesis.metric_proxy_rationale: At software_validity stage, mechanism fidelity is measured by exact causality invariance, zero-residual anchor parity, deadband HOLD invariance, Non-RL regime-gate sigmoid parity, trailing 1% capacity lock, and exact Decimal ledger agreement; Phase 0 study runner outputs PASS_PARITY_ONLY / STOP_FAIL_NO_RESCUE / INVALID strictly from structural validity and stop compliance.
thesis.stop_rule: Halt on any Phase 0 G2 oracle, architecture boundary, mypy, ruff, or distribution closure failure. Under this UNREVIEWED packet, run_study requires expected_protocol_digest equal to the frozen protocol digest and always enforces the Pre-FS1 embargo (timestamp, available_at, row alignment of feature and funding arrays, micro_available_at; enforce_pre_fs1=False is refused). trade_rl is network-free, so the G4 owner URL is only FORMAT-checked there (authorization_check=url_format_only): it cannot verify that the comment exists, who wrote it or what it says. Evidence eligibility requires a caller-built AuthorizationReceipt (comment id, author login and id, body sha256, fetched_at, quoted protocol digest) that run_study checks only for shape and for binding to the URL and the protocol digest; authentication itself is performed by the tools-layer adapter that fetches the comment, so a receipt is caller-attested. A URL without a receipt yields UNAUTHENTICATED_NOT_EVIDENCE and a URL-less synthetic run SYNTHETIC_ONLY_NOT_EVIDENCE (INVALID stays INVALID), never a parity or stop label as evidence; otherwise it fails closed. In any future separately authorized Phase 1 Tier D replay, any stopped cell or integrity failure yields STOP_FAIL_NO_RESCUE or INVALID with zero Tier D rescue; ANC_REGIME_GATE_NONRL domination diagnostics are reported directly rather than hidden; Phase 1 can never establish alpha.
